facts.business: Comfort Intech Limited is engaged in manufacturing, bottling, and distribution of Indian Made Foreign Liquor (IMFL) through its subsidiary Liquors India Limited, and trading of consumer durables, electronics, textiles, and agricultural commodities.

auditor.name: M/s. A.R. Sodha & Co., Chartered Accountants

key_risks: Business operations are concentrated in a limited number of states, resulting in geographical concentration risk.
Limited brand recognition compared to large national and multinational IMFL companies.
Dependence on state excise policies and licensing frameworks for business operations.
Smaller scale of operations may limit economies of scale and bargaining power in procurement.
facts.related_party_note: Loans given to related parties of Rs 1,551.76 lakh as at March 31, 2026 (Rs 1,878.05 lakh as at March 31, 2025).
